scenario.summary: pastes an out-of-stock SKU and a valid SKU (both with defaultQuantity) and checks the '2 SKUs couldn't be added' message.
steps: Quick Order, Add Multiple Items, Paste Multiple
Paste '<outOfStockProductSku>, <defaultQuantity>' and '<validSku>, <defaultQuantity>'; Add All to Quick List
stateChanges: Quick list left as is (consumed by the disabled AddToCartButtonDisableForOutOfStockProduct)
assertions: Message box text equals invalidProductValidationMessage ('2 SKUs couldn't be added ...')
evidence: Independent method (priority 75, no dependsOn): it opens the webstore itself and clears the quick list / cart at the end, so it declares its own needs. First method of the dependsOn pair with pasteMultipleSkusForGuestUserVerifyAddToCartButtonDisableForOutOfStockProduct (disabled): first method captures; the consumer reads outOfStockProduct and validProduct from the class field and has no needs.

outOfStockProductSku z-2200013 (quickOrderPage!C12): SimpleProduct 'Husqvarna 42 inch Mulching Capability Lawn Tractor', OutOfStockOptions DisablePurchasing (tda rows). Need outOfStockProduct = PRODUCT_SIMPLE_OUT_OF_STOCK {store} (no available inventory, DisablePurchasing, no required add-on). Preferred, not required.

validSku z-2460001 -> validProduct = PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 1, maxPersonalizableAttributes 0} (quickOrderPage!C11): active SimpleProduct 'Black + Decker 6.5 in Corded Angle Grinder', OutOfStockOptions DontTrackInventory, MinimumQuantity 1 / MaximumQuantity 100 (tda rows). The Playwright profile (2026-11-01) saw storefrontProductIndex 0; bin/tda readiness (2026-11-05) reports that the record now qualifies for these needs. Inventory 25 per warehouse row (tda rows dbo.ZnodeInventory). Preferred, not required.

REVIEW: both lines are pasted with defaultQuantity 0, and the asserted message is the zero-quantity / invalid-format message for 2 SKUs; it would appear even if neither product were out of stock, so the assertion does not prove the out-of-stock rule. Kept as is (the migration does not change the check); the out-of-stock need keeps the test's intent.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium shoppingCart entries and the Playwright quick-order entries.

Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); product facts come from bin/tda rows dbo.ZnodePimProduct (2026-11-05) and the approved Playwright quick-order entries.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
